headline: UK launches worlds largest trial to test artificial intelligence in breast cancer screening
label: NEWS
caption:
Artificial intelligence is stepping into healthcare in a massive way. 🩺

According to Gulf News and Anadolu, the UK has launched a major trial to test artificial intelligence in breast cancer screening.

The initiative is being described as the worlds largest trial of its kind, aiming to evaluate how AI technology performs in detecting breast cancer early.

Health authorities hope the trial will improve diagnostic accuracy and speed up the screening process for patients across the country.
